scopeText: Skip to main content > Hai Security page Program guidelines Scope Updates Domains envato.com envato.net envato.co themeforest.net Overview Envato Product Security Security and privacy at Envato starts with our values. At Envato, we understand security and privacy is important because we are in it for the community. This means we’re committed to working with our community, including through our security program to recognise helpful hackers that work with Envato.
